name: Typr-Server
description: Optional native LaTeX, TeXpresso, and scoped workspace service for Typr. Stateless by default; one dedicated workspace can be mapped explicitly. Trusted LAN/VPN use only; never expose it publicly.

paths.name: Workspace directory
paths.description: Optional one exact dedicated project directory. Never map /, /mnt, /mnt/user, a broad share, appdata root, symlinked root, or the Docker socket. UID 1000 needs read/write access.

ports.name: Typr Server port
ports.description: Host port used by the reverse proxy and local status checks. Container port must remain 8484.

variables.name: Allowed Typr origins
variables.description: Comma-separated exact browser origins, including scheme, host, and port with no path or trailing slash. Add the self-hosted Typr origin. CORS is not authentication.

variables.name: Allow stateless Unraid fallback
variables.description: Keep exactly 1 on stock Unraid: if Landlock is unavailable, allow trusted-document compilation only when no host workspace is mounted. A mapped workspace always fails closed without Landlock.

variables.name: Workspace API root
variables.description: Set exactly /workspace only when Workspace directory is configured. Leave blank to disable the file API.

variables.name: Workspace ID
variables.description: Stable opaque letters/numbers/dot/underscore/hyphen identifier for browser bindings; never put a host path here. Ignored while the API root is blank.
